	column 'Is Weekend'

	column 'Customer'
	column 'CustomerKey'
	column 'Gender'
	column 'State'

	column 'Zip Code'

table 'Product'
	column 'Brand'
	column 'Category'
	column 'Category Code'
	column 'Color'
	column 'Manufacturer'
	column 'Product'
	column 'Product Code'
	column 'ProductKey'
	column 'Subcategory'
	column 'Subcategory Code'
	column 'SupplierKey'
	column 'Unit Cost'
	column 'Unit Price'
	column 'Weight'
	column 'Weight Unit Measure'
	measure '# Products' =
			COUNTROWS('Product')

table 'Sales'
	column 'Currency Code'
	column 'CustomerKey'
	column 'Delivery Date'
	column 'Environment'
	column 'Exchange Rate'
	column 'Line Number'
	column 'Net Price'
	column 'Order Date'
	column 'Order Number'
	column 'ProductKey'
	column 'Quantity'
	column 'StoreKey'
	column 'Time'
	column 'Unit Cost'
	measure '# Customers (w/ Sales)' =
			DISTINCTCOUNT('Sales'[CustomerKey])
	measure '# Products (w/ Sales)' =
			DISTINCTCOUNT('Sales'[ProductKey])
	measure 'Sales Qty' =
			sum('Sales'[Quantity])
	measure 'Sales Amount' =
			SUMX('Sales', 'Sales'[Quantity] * 'Sales'[Net Price])
	measure 'Sales Amount (LY)' =
			IF ([Sales Amount] > 0, CALCULATE([Sales Amount], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Calendar'[Date])))
	measure 'Sales Amount Avg per Day' =
			AVERAGEX(VALUES('Calendar'[Date]), [Sales Amount])
	measure 'Margin' =
			SUMX (
			    Sales,
			    Sales[Quantity]
			        * ( Sales[Net Price] - Sales[Unit Cost] )
			)
	measure 'Margin (LY)' =
			CALCULATE([Margin], SAMEPERIODLASTYEAR('Calendar'[Date]))
	measure '# Sales' =
			COUNTROWS('Sales')
	measure 'Sales Amount (12M average)' =
			VAR v_selDate =
			    MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date] )
			VAR v_period =
			    DATESINPERIOD ( 'Calendar'[Date], v_selDate, -12, MONTH )
			VAR v_result =
			    CALCULATE ( AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Date] ), [Sales Amount] ), v_period )
			VAR v_firstDate =
			    MINX ( v_period, 'Calendar'[Date] )
			VAR v_lastDateSales =
			    MAX ( Sales[Order Date] )
			RETURN
			    IF ( v_firstDate <= v_lastDateSales, v_result )
	measure 'Sales Amount (6M average)' =
			VAR v_selDate =
			    MAX ( 'Calendar'[Date] )
			VAR v_period =
			    DATESINPERIOD ( 'Calendar'[Date], v_selDate, -6, MONTH )
			VAR v_result =
			    CALCULATE ( AVERAGEX ( VALUES ( 'Calendar'[Date] ), [Sales Amount] ), v_period )
			VAR v_firstDate =
			    MINX ( v_period, 'Calendar'[Date] )
			VAR v_lastDateSales =
			    MAX ( Sales[Order Date] )
			RETURN
			    IF ( v_firstDate <= v_lastDateSales, v_result )
	measure 'Margin %' =
			DIVIDE ( [Margin], [Sales Amount] )
	measure 'Cost' =
			SUMX ( Sales, Sales[Quantity] * Sales[Unit Cost] )

table 'Store'
